events.subtitle: THE REAL Veleria
events.category: Contemporary Japanese jazz / piano-trio-plus-strings ensemble / BODY&SOUL final week
events.factual_description: BODY&SOUL presents Kazuhiro Takemoto THE REAL Veleria on Wednesday, September 23, 2026. Doors open at 5:30 PM, with sets at 6:30 PM and 8:00 PM. The tax-included music charge is ¥7,000 and the venue currently marks reservations closed. The announced nine-person lineup is Takemoto on piano, Junichi Sato on bass, Kunito Kitai on drums, Kenta Okamoto on percussion, Atsuki Yoshida and Shiori Nishihara on violins, Sayaka Suehiro on viola, Kanato Iijima on cello, and guest singer Ema. Cotton Club documented the same nine-person configuration for Takemoto's THE REAL Veleria BIRTH release performance on February 9, 2026, describing it as an expansion of the piano trio formed in 2014 with percussion, string quartet and Ema. BODY&SOUL separately identifies September 26 as the grand finale of its 52nd year and says equipment removal begins the following week, placing this performance in the club's final operational week.

en.why_it_matters: Takemoto's core piano trio is stretched into a chamber-sized language here: percussion and a full string quartet surround the trio, while Ema adds the vocal voice tied to the BIRTH material. That orchestration gives the date an identity beyond an ordinary club set. Hearing the full configuration inside BODY&SOUL's final operational week adds real room-history without making the venue closure the only reason to care.
en.trip_verdict: If September 23 overlaps a Tokyo stay and a cancellation opens, catch it. With reservations currently closed, I would not reorganize a wider Kanto itinerary around uncertain admission.

es.why_it_matters: El trío base de Takemoto se expande aquí hasta volverse casi música de cámara: la percusión y un cuarteto completo de cuerdas rodean al piano, bajo y batería, mientras Ema incorpora la voz asociada al material de BIRTH. Esa orquestación le da a la fecha una identidad propia, muy distinta a un set ordinario de club. Escuchar la formación completa durante la última semana operativa de BODY&SOUL añade historia del lugar sin convertir el cierre en la única razón para estar ahí.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 23 de septiembre coincide con una estancia en Tokio y se abre una cancelación, la agarraría. Con las reservas cerradas por ahora, no reorganizaría un itinerario más amplio por Kanto alrededor de una entrada incierta.
